title: Gamification scope, scoring and consent
question: Do we build capture gamification? If so, how are points, project-level scores and benchmarks calculated, who sees leaderboards, how is consent recorded, and do companies give real-world rewards?
context: The gamification PRD describes streaks, coverage and quality scoring, opt-in leaderboards and safety scores, and lists rewards and project scoring as open. No code exists (ENT-REQ-018).
